DescriptionEnglish: Increases melee damage by 100%; bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone.
DescriptionChinese: 近战伤害提升100%；更不易被击倒。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides 40% resistance to fire gas acid and electrical damage; increases throwing range by 20%.
DescriptionChinese: 火焰/毒气/酸液/电击伤害抗性+40%；投掷距离+20%。

DescriptionEnglish: Wearer makes 50% less noise when moving; increases point-of-interest identification range by 30%; provides immunity to leg injuries.
DescriptionChinese: 移动噪音-50%；兴趣点识别范围+30%；免疫腿部伤害。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides one-time short resuscitation upon death (if body intact); increases stim duration by 2.0s; provides 50% resistance to arc damage.
DescriptionChinese: 死亡后一次短暂复苏（尸体完整时）；兴奋剂持续+2秒；电弧伤害抗性+50%。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides 25% resistance to chest damage and explosive damage; prevents bleeding chest damage.
DescriptionChinese: 胸部伤害抗性+25%；爆炸伤害抗性+25%；免疫出血。

DescriptionEnglish: Increases primary reload speed by 30%; 50% chance to avoid grievous limb injury; increases melee damage by 50%.
DescriptionChinese: 主武器装填速度+30%；50%概率避免严重肢体伤害；近战伤害+50%。

DescriptionEnglish: Increases sidearm reload speed by 40%; increases draw/holster speed by 50%; reduces sidearm recoil by 70%.
DescriptionChinese: 副武器装填速度+40%；拔枪/收枪速度+50%；副武器后坐力-70%。

DescriptionEnglish: Armor explodes 1.5s after wearer dies; increases initial inventory and carrying capacity of throwables by +2.
DescriptionChinese: 死亡1.5秒后护甲引爆；投掷物初始与携带量+2。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides 50% resistance to fire gas acid and electrical damage.
DescriptionChinese: 火焰/毒气/酸液/电击伤害抗性+50%。

DescriptionEnglish: Increases primary reload speed by 30%; increases ammo capacity of all weapons by 20% (except weapon backpacks).
DescriptionChinese: 主武器装填速度+30%；所有武器弹药容量+20%（不含背包武器）。

DescriptionEnglish: Helps prevent flinching when hit; provides higher armor rating; map markers generate radar scans every 2.0s.
DescriptionChinese: 受击不易硬直；提升护甲等级；地图标记每2秒触发扫描。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides 80% resistance to gas damage and effects.
DescriptionChinese: 毒气伤害与效果抗性+80%。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides 75% damage resistance to fire.
DescriptionChinese: 火焰伤害抗性+75%。

DescriptionEnglish: Increases melee damage by 100%; improves weapon handling.
DescriptionChinese: 近战伤害+100%；武器操控更顺手。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides 95% resistance to arc damage.
DescriptionChinese: 电弧伤害抗性+95%。

DescriptionEnglish: Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by 30%; provides 50% resistance to explosive damage.
DescriptionChinese: 蹲伏/卧倒时后坐力-30%；爆炸伤害抗性+50%。

DescriptionEnglish: Map markers generate radar scans every 2.0s; reduces enemy detection range by 30%.
DescriptionChinese: 地图标记每2秒触发扫描；敌人探测范围-30%。

DescriptionEnglish: Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by 30%; increases throwables capacity by +2.
DescriptionChinese: 蹲伏/卧倒后坐力-30%；投掷物容量+2。

DescriptionEnglish: Increases initial and carrying capacity of stims by +2; increases stim duration by 2.0s.
DescriptionChinese: 兴奋剂初始与携带量+2；持续+2秒。

DescriptionEnglish: Increases throwing range by 30%; provides +50% limb health.
DescriptionChinese: 投掷距离+30%；肢体生命值+50%。

DescriptionEnglish: 50% chance to not die when taking lethal damage; prevents bleeding chest damage.
DescriptionChinese: 遭受致命伤时50%概率免死；免疫出血。

DescriptionEnglish: Provides a higher armor rating.
DescriptionChinese: 提升护甲等级。
